title: Tony Wright (Terrorvision) Live Aboard The Golden Hinde
description:
Step aboard The Golden Hinde for an intimate evening with acclaimed singer-songwriter and Terrorvision frontman Tony Wright.

Best known as the unmistakable voice behind Bradford rock favourites Terrorvision, Tony has also built a remarkable solo career, showcasing a different side of his songwriting through heartfelt, acoustic-led performances. Trading high-octane rock for a more personal and reflective setting, his solo shows reveal an artist equally at home with uplifting melodies, poignant storytelling, and sharp observations of everyday life.

When not touring with Terrorvision, Wright writes, records and performs under his own name, drawing inspiration from wherever he finds it. Across three solo albums - Thoughts 'n' All, Walnut Dash, and the ambitious The Anti Album - he has crafted a body of work that is thoughtful, honest, and distinctly his own.

Renowned for his warmth, humour and engaging stage presence, Tony's solo performances create a genuine connection with audiences, blending stories and songs in equal measure. Whether you're a lifelong Terrorvision fan or discovering his solo work for the first time, this promises to be a memorable evening of exceptional songwriting and intimate live music.

Set within the atmospheric surroundings of a historic Tudor ship, this is a rare opportunity to experience one of the UK's most distinctive songwriters up close aboard one of London's most unique music venues.
address: The Golden Hinde, St Mary Overie's Dock, Cathedral St, London, SE1 9DE

title: Christmas at Sea: A Festive Museum Late
description:
Ever wondered what Christmas was like aboard a Tudor ship? Or how sailors celebrated the festive season when they were hundreds of miles from home?

Join us aboard The Golden Hinde for a special Christmas Museum Late, as we explore festive traditions, Tudor celebrations and some of the more unusual ways Christmas has been spent at sea.

From festive feasts to Christmas celebrations on voyages across the centuries, we're bringing a little seasonal history to Bankside, with talks, creative activities and a chance to explore the ship after hours.

The Hinde Bar will also be open throughout the evening!

Christmas Talks

Two short talks will be held in the Hold, each exploring a different side of Christmas history.

6.30PM - Tudor Christmas Traditions & Customs

What did people eat at Christmas in Tudor England? Discover the foods, customs and celebrations that made the festive season such an important part of the Tudor calendar.

7.30PM - Christmas at Sea

From Tudor voyages to Antarctic expeditions, discover how sailors and explorers have celebrated Christmas in some extraordinary circumstances, often thousands of miles from home.

Make Your Own Maritime Christmas Card

Fancy getting creative? Have a go at making your own maritime-inspired Christmas card!

Using historical images, nautical scenes and festive illustrations, create a Christmas collage to take home or send to someone special.

A Christmas Trail with a Twist

Drop-in throughout the evening.

Our Christmas Trail is getting a Museum Late makeover, with a few extra challenges for our evening visitors.

Follow clues and riddles around the ship, explore its decks and cabins, and see if you can uncover the final secret word.

Whether you're joining us for the history, getting stuck into the workshop or simply fancy a festive evening somewhere a little different, we'd love to welcome you aboard.

Date: Thursday 3 December 2026

Start time: 6pm

Venue:The Golden Hinde, St Mary Overie Dock, London SE1 9DE
address: The Golden Hinde, St Mary Overie's Dock, Cathedral St, London, SE1 9DE

Spend an intimate evening aboard The Golden Hinde with two of the UK's most acclaimed singer-songwriters, Kathryn Williams and Withered Hand, as they perform songs from their celebrated collaboration alongside music from their acclaimed solo careers.

Mercury Prize-nominated Kathryn Williams has released sixteen albums over a career spanning more than two decades, collaborating with artists including Paul Weller, Neill MacColl and Michele & Romeo Stodart. Alongside her music, she is a novelist, podcaster and creative writing tutor.

Scottish songwriter Withered Hand (Dan Willson) has built a devoted following through his deeply personal songwriting, releasing three critically acclaimed albums and touring internationally while remaining firmly rooted in the independent music scene.

Although they shared many mutual friends, Kathryn and Dan first met in Edinburgh in 2019 before beginning a songwriting partnership built on conversation, friendship and a shared exploration of grief, memory and hope. Continuing to write together throughout lockdown, they created a collection of songs that reflects their thoughtful, collaborative approach, with music shaped as much by late-night conversations as by traditional songwriting.

Set against the unique surroundings of The Golden Hinde, this special performance offers the chance to experience two exceptional artists in one of London's most intimate and atmospheric venues.

title: Goodbye Matrix Live Aboard The Golden Hinde
description:
Join us aboard The Golden Hinde for an evening of atmospheric live music with Goodbye Matrix, a trip-hop collective blending cinematic soundscapes, shadowy atmospheres and off-kilter pop.

Trip hop collective Goodbye Matrix are entering a new chapter. Bringing together Christian Piers, a London-based electronic music producer and DJ who has been an underground staple, known for his agile sonic transitions and distinctive, dubbed-out industrial signature spanning house, techno, breakbeat and drum and bass, with singer/songwriter Miryea Meek, a human rights and environmental activist inspired by the oddities of suburban life and the aesthetics of 1960s cinema.

Blending their contrasting worlds into trip-hop, cinematic soundscapes and seductive, off-kilter pop, the collective is forging a distinctive sound that blurs genre boundaries and explores the stranger edges of the everyday. With an EP scheduled for release in 2027, the collective is building anticipation. Join them for an exclusive showcase of new material, a festive Christmas get-together celebrating the beginning of an exciting new chapter.

Experience Goodbye Matrix's distinctive sound in the intimate, atmospheric surroundings of our historic Tudor galleon, for a live performance unlike any other.

description:

title: Silver & Gold
description:
LONG JOHN SILVER is a legend in his own lifetime. Treacherous. Murderous. Infamous. PIRATICAL. The only problem is, he's not happy with the legend and he'll do anything to set the record straight, even at the cost of his very last breath...

From Brother Wolf, the multi award-winning creators of 'Fagin's Last Hour' and 'A Christmas Carol - As told by Jacob Marley (deceased)', comes SILVER & GOLD (based on 'Treasure Island'), making its unmissable return on board the majestic Golden Hinde -- a full-size reconstruction of the Elizabethan galleon ship, situated on the banks of the River Thames in the heart of the Capital's centre of culture.

Climb on deck and join Captain Silver for this critically acclaimed, award nominated and historically accurate theatrical event, sailing into Bankside dock this coming December!

Praise for SILVER & GOLD:

"Anchored on the legendary Golden Hinde, James Hyland's spellbinding SILVER & GOLD is a masterclass in storytelling, transporting its audience to the high seas and the darkest depths of human nature. It's a truly unforgettable performance... The characterisation was utterly incredible. The way Hyland embodied Silver was nothing short of breathtaking... It's a complete tour de force performance that left me completely captivated... Theatre doesn't get more immersive or atmospheric than this... This is theatre as it should be. Raw, engaging, and unapologetic."

★★★★★​​ ~Pink Prince Theatre

"Is there anywhere better for a swashbuckling story about a pirate (although he goes to pains to say he is not) trying to change his story, than on the lower decks of a full-sized reconstruction of the Elizabethan galleon? Absolutely not. As soon as he enters down the ship's stairs, Hyland’s characterisation of Long John Silver is exceptional. He has such a strong stage presence and embodies Silver with a vivid intensity which creates an incredibly engaging atmosphere... What makes it even more immersive, was him making us part of crew... it was incredible. Theatre does not get any more immersive or atmospheric than this – everything was ship shape and anchored in the talents of James Hyland, and the story of a maligned pirate that he has masterfully created."

★★★★★​​ ~Theatre South East

"I saw SILVER & GOLD by Brother Wolf staged below deck on the Golden Hinde which, for those of you who don't know, is a full scale reconstruction of an Elizabethan galleon sitting just off the bank of the Thames. Genuinely, find me a cooler venue for a play about pirates and I'll buy you a drink. So, the show is inspired by 'Treasure Island' and told from the mouth of Long John Silver himself. It was fully immersive sitting crammed together under the wooden boards, genuinely feeling like we're about to mutiny. It was funny, gripping and properly engaging from start to finish. The audience participation is chaotic and hilarious... The acting was genuinely brilliant. Huge shout out to James Hyland for truly committing to the bit and creating such a solid characterisation for the legendary pirate. It was such a smart concept, such a fun night and honestly an easy five stars from me."

★★★★★ ~She Reviews Theatre LDN

"Hyland delivers a high-octane performance, inhabiting the character of Long John Silver expertly and with striking nuance... The directness and richness of Silver's characterisation vividly brings him to life in this brilliantly constructed narrative... Hyland has created another compelling and immersive story that plunges the audience into a gripping piratical adventure... A truly outstanding show that lets a maligned character stand tall and unrepentant."

★★★★★ ~A Shiny Life For Me!

"Is there anywhere better to tell a swashbuckling story about the fictional pirate Long John Silver than on the lower decks of the Golden Hinde, a glorious full-scale reconstruction of the 16th-century English galleon... Hyland has a powerful stage presence... A huge credit to Hyland for giving a strong convincing performance throughout."

★★★★★ ~Theatre & Arts Reviews

"Silver & Gold is a definite must see show. Hyland's brash and comedic character brings a fascinating story to life for all to enjoy. A masterpiece in its entirety."

★★★★★ ~British Theatre Journal

"the setting adds a layer of authenticity and intimacy that a traditional theatre simply couldn't replicate... we were no longer mere spectators — we were Silver's new crew. Silver, played with formidable energy by James Hyland, commands the space... Hyland's ability to hold the audience's attention throughout is impressive. The pacing is taut, the storytelling vivid... for those with a love of theatre, history, and storytelling, it's a rare treat... experiencing this tale aboard such a historic ship, right in the heart of London, was a delight — a theatrical voyage worth taking."

~Number 9

READ THE REVIEWS IN FULL: https://www.brotherwolf.org.uk/silver-and-gold-reviews

A Brother Wolf Production

Based on 'Treasure Island' by Robert Louis Stevenson

Adapted, Produced, Directed and Performed by James Hyland

title: Attila The Stockbroker Live Aboard The Golden Hinde
description:
Step aboard The Golden Hinde for an evening of poetry, music and uncompromising live performance with Attila The Stockbroker.

Powerful, passionate, personal and political, Attila has been performing his distinctive combination of poetry and music for more than four decades. His live show brings together hard-hitting poems, acoustic songs and dub poetry, alongside a taste of his early music material.

Since beginning his career in 1980, Attila has performed more than 4,000 gigs across 26 countries, building a reputation for energetic performances that combine spoken word, music, humour and social commentary. His career has also produced ten books of poetry, more than 20 albums, an autobiography and a collection spanning decades of his work.

For this special December performance, Attila brings his words and music to the atmospheric surroundings of The Golden Hinde for an intimate evening aboard one of London's most distinctive venues.

  • Performance aboard The Golden Hinde

title: Ags Connolly Live Aboard The Golden Hinde
description:
Step aboard The Golden Hinde for an intimate evening with one of the UK's most celebrated traditional country artists, Ags Connolly.

Hailed as "Britain's premier traditional country artist" by Saving Country Music and "one of the most important voices in UK roots music" by BBC broadcaster Ralph McLean, Connolly has built an international reputation for heartfelt songwriting, timeless melodies and an unwavering commitment to classic country music.

Since the release of his acclaimed debut album How About Now in 2014, Connolly has earned widespread praise on both sides of the Atlantic, with four critically acclaimed original albums and numerous industry accolades, including Album of the Year at the 2020 UK Country Music Awards for Wrong Again. His authentic approach has seen him share stages with country legends including Rosanne Cash, Asleep At The Wheel, Dale Watson, Jim Lauderdale, and more recently, Charley Crockett on his major European tour.

Combining rich storytelling with warm, understated performances, Connolly's songs draw deeply from the traditions of classic country while offering a distinctive voice that is entirely his own. Whether you're a lifelong country fan or discovering the genre for the first time, his live performances are renowned for their honesty, musicianship and quiet brilliance.

Set within the atmospheric surroundings of a historic Tudor ship, this is a rare opportunity to experience one of Britain's finest country singer-songwriters in an unforgettable and intimate setting.
address: The Golden Hinde, St Mary Overie's Dock, Cathedral St, London, SE1 9DE

title: Brooke Law Presents ‘The Golden Hinde Sunday Sessions’
description:
Singer-songwriter Brooke Law is set to launch a new series of intimate live music performances aboard The Golden Hinde in 2027, bringing together original songwriting, special guest artists and one of London's most distinctive historic venues.

Brooke Law Presents ‘The Golden Hinde Sunday Sessions’ will take place across four Sundays between January and April 2027, offering audiences the opportunity to experience live music in the atmospheric surroundings of the ship's historic timber interior. Presented as part of the ship's BAR-NACLES: Rock the Boat live music programme, the series will bring together original songwriting, special guest artists and one of London's most distinctive historic venues.

Each session will see Brooke joined by two special guest singer-songwriters for an intimate, collaborative performance, sharing original songs and the stories behind them. With an audience capacity of approximately 70, the series promises a rare opportunity to experience established and emerging artists up close.

Brooke Law invites us to strip away the noise of modern life and stand tall in our own truth with provocative rock to soulful confessionals that challenge and comfort in a dangerously artificial world.

Her powerful voice, akin to rock icons yet wholly her own, blends grit and grace cueing to the core and is both defiant and soulful. With influences ranging from Janis Joplin to Alanis Morissette, Brooke’s voice shifts from vulnerable whispers to defiant roars.
November 2025 saw the release of the album ‘Naked Heart’ in CD and digital formats with the vinyl released in February 2026 all promoted with band tours in Spring and Autumn 2026. A studio album is planned for a Spring 2027 release.

The Sunday Sessions form part of BAR-NACLES: Rock the Boat, The Golden Hinde's live music programme, which brings contemporary artists and audiences together in the distinctive surroundings of the historic ship. With its emphasis on original songwriting, collaboration and intimate performances, Brooke Law's new series offers another dimension to the programme.

‘The Golden Hinde Sunday Sessions’ not only offers the opportunity to experience the ship but to enjoy the musicians showcasing their skills in one of the most original settings anywhere.
address: The Golden Hinde, St Mary Overie's Dock, Cathedral St, London, SE1 9DE

title: The Cords (Acoustic) + Special Guests Foglights
description:
Join us aboard The Golden Hinde for an intimate acoustic performance from Scottish indiepop duo The Cords, with special guests Foglights.

Sisters Eva and Grace Tedeschi are two of the most exciting names to emerge from Scotland's thriving indiepop scene. Drawing inspiration from the jangling guitars and infectious melodies of '80s and '90s indie, The Cords have quickly built a reputation for their irresistible hooks, raw energy and unmistakable musical chemistry.

With Eva on guitar and lead vocals and Grace on drums, the sisters have made quite an impression since their live debut alongside The Vaselines. They've since shared stages with Camera Obscura, Belle and Sebastian and BMX Bandits, and recently toured the UK with The Charlatans.

Their early releases caught the attention of BBC Radio 6 Music, leading to a session for Riley & Coe, while their acclaimed debut album established them as ones to watch. Now, with a highly anticipated second album on the way through Skep Wax and Slumberland Records, The Cords are entering an exciting new chapter.

Their sound brings together the fuzzy guitars and melodic charm of bands like The Shop Assistants, Talulah Gosh and The Jesus and Mary Chain, with a dreamy, occasionally darker edge that feels entirely their own.

For this special acoustic show aboard The Golden Hinde, expect a more intimate take on the songs that have made The Cords such an exciting presence in contemporary indiepop.

With special guests Foglights.

title: Kiiōtō Live Aboard The Golden Hinde
description:
Step aboard The Golden Hinde for an intimate evening of live music with Kiiōtō, the collaboration between Mercury Music Prize-nominated singer-songwriter Lou Rhodes, former lead vocalist and co-founder of Lamb, and award-winning songwriter and pianist Rohan Heath.

Following their critically acclaimed 2024 debut As Dust We Rise, Kiiōtō return with their second album, Black Salt – a bold and deeply personal collection of songs spanning jazz, broken beat and soul, brought together by Heath's melodic sensibilities and Rhodes' unmistakable voice.

Across the album, the duo cast their net wide, exploring everything from modern relationships and the influence of social media to parenthood, heritage, loss and our place in the world. The arrangements remain spare and distinctive, drawing on influences as varied as Carole King, Khruangbin and Alice Coltrane.

Written primarily in Kiiōtō's North London home studio and released independently on their own label, Black Salt also features contributions from a host of musicians, including guitarist Hawi Gondwe, double-bassist Andy Hamill, drummer Mykey Wilson and composer and musician David Arnold.

Join Kiiōtō aboard The Golden Hinde for a special performance in the atmospheric surroundings of one of London's most unique live music venues.
address: The Golden Hinde, St Mary Overie's Dock, Cathedral St, London, SE1 9DE

title: Tom Robinson with Adam Phillips Live
description:
Join us aboard The Golden Hinde for a special evening of live music with Tom Robinson, pioneering musician, songwriter and broadcaster, joined by Adam Phillips.

A defining voice of British punk and a lifelong champion of independent music, Tom Robinson first emerged in the mid-1970s as part of acoustic harmony trio Café Society, whose debut album was produced by Ray Davies of The Kinks. Inspired by the arrival of punk, he went on to form the Tom Robinson Band, achieving chart success with the iconic 2-4-6-8 Motorway and releasing the groundbreaking LGBT anthem Glad To Be Gay.

An early supporter of Rock Against Racism, Robinson became a prominent figure in the movement, performing alongside artists including The Clash, Steel Pulse and X-Ray Spex. His band's debut album, Power in the Darkness, reached No. 4 in the UK charts and remains an enduring part of British punk history.

Across a career spanning five decades, Robinson has collaborated with Elton John and Peter Gabriel, toured with The Police and The Undertones, and established himself as a respected voice in broadcasting. Through his BBC Introducing shows, he has helped bring more than 10,000 emerging artists to national radio audiences.

Now celebrated for his sharp songwriting, wit and electrifying stage presence, Robinson continues to captivate audiences with performances that combine powerful music, storytelling and the rebellious spirit that first made him a household name.

Don't miss this opportunity to experience Tom Robinson with Adam Phillips in the intimate, atmospheric surroundings of our historic Tudor galleon.

title: Chris Helme (Seahorses) Live Aboard The Golden Hinde
description:
Step aboard The Golden Hinde for an intimate evening with acclaimed singer-songwriter and former Seahorses frontman Chris Helme.

From his breakthrough success with John Squire's post-Stone Roses band The Seahorses to a rich and enduring solo career, Chris Helme has built a reputation for deeply personal songwriting, powerful vocals, and captivating live performances. His songs combine raw emotion with melodic craftsmanship, creating music that resonates as strongly today as it did during the height of Britpop.

This special performance comes as Helme celebrates his latest album, Forest For The Trees, a warm and beautifully stripped-back collection revisiting songs from across his career. Reimagining Seahorses favourites alongside highlights from his solo catalogue, the album reveals the timeless songwriting and emotional depth at the heart of his music.

Renowned for his engaging acoustic performances, Helme brings both intimacy and intensity to the stage, effortlessly balancing grit, soul and humour. Whether revisiting classics such as Blinded By The Sun and Love Me And Leave Me or showcasing newer material, his live shows offer a rare opportunity to experience these songs in their purest form.

Set within the atmospheric surroundings of a historic Tudor ship, this is a unique chance to experience one of Britain's most distinctive voices up close aboard one of London's most remarkable music venues.
address: The Golden Hinde, St Mary Overie's Dock, Cathedral St, London, SE1 9DE

title: Brooke Law Presents ‘The Golden Hinde Sunday Sessions’
description:
Singer-songwriter Brooke Law is set to launch a new series of intimate live music performances aboard The Golden Hinde in 2027, bringing together original songwriting, special guest artists and one of London's most distinctive historic venues.

Brooke Law Presents ‘The Golden Hinde Sunday Sessions’ will take place across four Sundays between January and April 2027, offering audiences the opportunity to experience live music in the atmospheric surroundings of the ship's historic timber interior. Presented as part of the ship's BAR-NACLES: Rock the Boat live music programme, the series will bring together original songwriting, special guest artists and one of London's most distinctive historic venues.

Each session will see Brooke joined by two special guest singer-songwriters for an intimate, collaborative performance, sharing original songs and the stories behind them. With an audience capacity of approximately 70, the series promises a rare opportunity to experience established and emerging artists up close.

Brooke Law invites us to strip away the noise of modern life and stand tall in our own truth with provocative rock to soulful confessionals that challenge and comfort in a dangerously artificial world.

Her powerful voice, akin to rock icons yet wholly her own, blends grit and grace cueing to the core and is both defiant and soulful. With influences ranging from Janis Joplin to Alanis Morissette, Brooke’s voice shifts from vulnerable whispers to defiant roars.
November 2025 saw the release of the album ‘Naked Heart’ in CD and digital formats with the vinyl released in February 2026 all promoted with band tours in Spring and Autumn 2026. A studio album is planned for a Spring 2027 release.

The Sunday Sessions form part of BAR-NACLES: Rock the Boat, The Golden Hinde's live music programme, which brings contemporary artists and audiences together in the distinctive surroundings of the historic ship. With its emphasis on original songwriting, collaboration and intimate performances, Brooke Law's new series offers another dimension to the programme.

‘The Golden Hinde Sunday Sessions’ not only offers the opportunity to experience the ship but to enjoy the musicians showcasing their skills in one of the most original settings anywhere.
address: The Golden Hinde, St Mary Overie's Dock, Cathedral St, London, SE1 9DE

title: Savannah Gardner Live Aboard The Golden Hinde
description:
Join us aboard The Golden Hinde for a special evening of live music with Savannah Gardner, the genre-bending country artist whose distinctive sound brings together classic country, outlaw Americana, jazz and blues.

Known for her captivating voice, theatrical performances and refreshingly individual approach to songwriting, Savannah has been making waves on the country music scene, building a loyal following through her raw, expressive music and powerful connection with audiences.

Having performed at major festivals including Glastonbury and C2C London, Savannah's growing reputation has taken her well beyond the UK. In 2026, she was named Female Vocalist of the Year at the Texas Sounds International Country Music Awards, recognising her talent on an international stage.

Her debut album, Recovering Good Girl, was produced by Dale Davis, former musical director for Amy Winehouse. Blending influences from across country, jazz and blues, the album showcases Savannah's distinctive musical identity and storytelling.

Now, Savannah brings her music to the intimate, atmospheric surroundings of The Golden Hinde. With her expressive vocals, theatrical flair and genre-defying sound, this promises to be a memorable evening of live music aboard London's famous Tudor galleon.

Event Details

Date: Wednesday 12 May 2027

Doors: 7.30pm

Performance: 8pm

Venue:The Golden Hinde, St Mary Overie Dock, London Bridge, SE1 9DE
address: The Golden Hinde, St Mary Overie's Dock, Cathedral St, London, SE1 9DE

title: Mark Radcliffe & David Boardman Live
description:
Join us aboard The Golden Hinde for an intimate evening of music and storytelling with broadcaster, author and musician Mark Radcliffe, accompanied by acclaimed guitarist and singer David Boardman.

Best known for his long career on BBC Radio, including Radio 2's Folk Show and 6 Music, Mark has spent decades championing music both on and off the airwaves. Alongside David Boardman, he brings together beautifully crafted original songs, thoughtful storytelling and a healthy dose of dry humour in a live show that is as engaging as it is entertaining.

Performing tracks from their latest album, Hearsay and Heresy, alongside carefully chosen covers and tales from Mark's remarkable career in music and broadcasting, this promises to be an unforgettable evening in one of London's most atmospheric performance venues.

Whether you're a long-time listener, a folk music enthusiast or simply looking for a unique live music experience, don't miss the opportunity to see Mark Radcliffe & David Boardman aboard one of London's most iconic historic ships.
address: The Golden Hinde, St Mary Overie's Dock, Cathedral St, London, SE1 9DE

title: Belinda O'Hooley Live Aboard The Golden Hinde
description:
Tuesday 22 June 2027
Doors 7.30pm | Performance 8pm

Step aboard The Golden Hinde for an intimate evening of live music with award-winning singer, songwriter, pianist and composer Belinda O’Hooley.

Renowned for her distinctive voice, powerful piano playing and fearless storytelling, Belinda is one half of acclaimed folk duo O’Hooley & Tidow, with whom she has toured internationally and received four BBC Radio 2 Folk Award nominations. She also co-wrote “Gentleman Jack”, the closing theme to Sally Wainwright’s hit BBC/HBO drama of the same name.

Now forging a solo path, Belinda brings together folk tradition, contemporary songwriting and her distinctive piano style to create music that is moving, witty, political and deeply human.

Alongside her music, Belinda has also appeared on screen as DCS Liz Thornton in the BAFTA-winning series Happy Valley.

Join us below deck for a special performance in the atmospheric surroundings of one of London’s most unique live music venues.

“Exquisite” ★★★★★ – The Guardian
“Dense, complex, beautifully performed.” ★★★★ – Songlines
address: The Golden Hinde, St Mary Overie's Dock, Cathedral St, London, SE1 9DE

title: Claude Bourbon Live Aboard The Golden Hinde
description:
Wednesday 6 October 2027
Doors 7.30pm | Music from 8pm

Step aboard The Golden Hinde for an evening of extraordinary guitar playing with Claude Bourbon, whose captivating performances bring together musical traditions from across the world.

Known throughout Europe and America for his remarkable technique, Claude's music moves effortlessly between the blues of the Mississippi Delta, the warmth of the Balearic Islands and the rich musical traditions of the Balkans. Rooted in classical guitar, his distinctive sound blends Spanish blues, Gypsy rhythms, Eastern European melodies and touches of flamenco.

Drawing inspiration from artists and composers as varied as Paco de Lucía, Ritchie Blackmore, Joaquín Rodrigo, JJ Cale and J.S. Bach, Claude brings an astonishing range of influences together in intricate and expressive performances.

Over the course of his career, Claude has performed at venues across Europe and America and shared stages with musicians including Calvin Russell, Charlie Morgan (Elton John, Gary Moore), Jan Akkerman (Focus), Steve Grossman (Miles Davis), Herbie Armstrong (Van Morrison) and José Barrense-Dias.

Expect an intimate evening of blues, folk, classical and Spanish guitar, brought together by a musician with exceptional timing, technique and a style entirely his own.

"A breathtaking acoustic fusion of blues, jazz, classical and Spanish guitar from a stunning guitar virtuoso..."
- Altadena News, USA

Event Details

Date: Wednesday 6 October 2027
Doors: 7.30pm
Music: 8pm
Venue:The Golden Hinde, St Mary Overie Dock, Cathedral Street, London SE1 9DE

Please note: Due to the historic nature of the ship, access involves steep stairs and uneven surfaces.
